label: Kingstone consolidated company
definition: Consolidated Kingstone subsidiary financial table, covering ion implanters, spares, services and remanufacturing.

label: Kingstone 12-inch ion-implanter cumulative milestones
definition: Source-native cumulative orders and cumulative deliveries for 12-inch IC ion-implanter systems; use a disclosure-date proxy when the original says 2020年至今 without an explicit period-end bridge.

label: Kingstone H1 12-inch ion-implanter operating milestone
definition: Source-native H1 shipment milestone explicitly limited to 12-inch ion-implanter systems.

label: Kingstone generic ion-implanter operating milestones
definition: Source-native generic ion-implanter acceptance, customer-count and cumulative-delivery milestones. Do not attach a 12-inch qualifier absent from the specific sentence. Covers acceptance, customer-count, cumulative-delivery, production-lines-served and fleet wafer-throughput milestones; the list is descriptive, not closed.

label: 低能大束流离子注入机
definition: Kingstone source-native operating milestones stated specifically for the low-energy high-current implanter line.

label: 先进制程低能大束流离子注入机 (Hyperion)
definition: Kingstone source-native operating milestones for the advanced-node low-energy high-current implanter, disclosed as distinct from the base low-energy high-current line.

label: 超低温离子注入机
definition: Kingstone source-native operating milestones for the cryogenic implanter line.

label: 高能离子注入机
definition: Kingstone source-native operating milestones for the high-energy implanter line.

label: 中束流离子注入机 (iKing-360)
definition: Kingstone source-native operating milestones for the medium-current implanter line, first disclosed in H1 2026.

label: 12-inch implanters, annual
definition: Kingstone source-native full-financial-year operating milestones explicitly limited to 12-inch implanters. Distinct from the existing cumulative and H1-only 12-inch scopes; annual flows must not be read against either.

label: Repeat-order customers
definition: Kingstone source-native count of existing customers placing repeat or volume-repeat orders in the stated period. Complementary to kingstone_new_customer_order_milestones; the two sum to the period ordering-customer total and must not be added to it.

label: Newly won customers
definition: Kingstone source-native count of new customers won in the stated period. Complementary to kingstone_repeat_order_customer_milestones; see that scope's note on summation.

label: Same-year delivery and acceptance customers
definition: Kingstone source-native count of customers for which equipment was both delivered and accepted within one financial year. A disclosed subset of the ordering-customer base, not an independent total.

label: 低能大束流离子注入机 — delivered domestic fleet, 12-inch wafers
definition: Kingstone operating milestones doubly narrowed by the source: the already-delivered domestic low-energy high-current implanter fleet AND 12-inch wafers. Kept separate from kingstone_low_energy_high_current_implant_operating_milestones so an unqualified product-line figure cannot silently join this series.
